family_aggregation.description: Variants grouped by heuristic family (rule-based WAF: interpret as cohort-level rates, not i.i.d. trials per variant).

methodology.sources_probe: aws_probe_results.jsonl (per-variant attempts, Wilson 95% CI on bypass rate)
methodology.family_aggregation: Heuristic cohorts in variant_families.py (+ variant_family_rules.json): larger n per row than single-variant rates; suited for rule-based WAF reporting.
methodology.generalization: multiple data roots; Spearman variant- and family-level where both envs have probe logs
